title: 9 What is the vſe of this doctrine.

segments.text: THE vſe of this doctrine is, 1. That the glorie of our ſaluation be in whole aſcribed and giuen to God. What haſt thou that thou haſt not receiued? 2. That we may haue ſure and certain comfort. This we ſhall haue, when as wee ſhall not doubt of thoſe things, which are here taught; and that eſpecially, if euerie of vs be certainely perſwaded that the decree of God of ſauing his elect is altogether vnchangeable, and further that himſelf alſo is of the number of the elect, euen a member of the inuiſible Church, and therefore ſh•ll neuer depart from the Church and communion of Saints: becauſe it is ſanctified of God, and therefore is holy and conformed vnto God, not in perfection, but is holy firſt by imputation, by reaſon of the holines of Chriſt imputed vnto it; next by inchoation, becauſe the holy Ghoſt dooth by little and little renew it, and repu•ge it from the filth of ſinne: and laſtly it is holy, becauſe it is dedicated to a holy, ſacred and diuine vſe, and ſeuered from the wicked, which are without the church. To beleeue therefore the holy Church, is, to beleeue, that in this viſible companie and ſociety are ſome true repentants and truely conuerted, and my ſelfe to be a liuely member of the inuiſible and viſible Church.
